deadline.value: Non-Canadian applicants apply by April 1, 2027 for September entry (Canadians June 1).
deadline.quote: For September admission: June 1 (Canadian applicants), April 1 (non-Canadian applicants)

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field; ETS offers Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

supervisor.value: Acceptance is conditional on finding and confirming a supervisor; name two or more potential supervisors in your application letter.
supervisor.quote: Acceptance is conditional upon finding and confirming a supervisor. | The names of two or more potential thesis supervisors (see Our Faculty for faculty research interests) should be included in your letter.

funding.value: All graduate students in the School receive funding.
funding.quote: All graduate students in the School of Biomedical Engineering receive funding to support their studies.

entry_route.value: Apply from a thesis-based master's in health, engineering or physical science, or transfer from the School's MASc.
entry_route.quote: You may apply from a thesis-based master's programs in any health, engineering or physical science discipline. | If you are already in the MASc program, you may transfer to a PhD program after you complete three half-classes and a successful PhD Transfer Examination.

gre_general.value: GRE scores are recommended for applicants whose undergraduate degree is from outside Canada (PhD applicants must meet the MASc entry requirements).
gre_general.quote: GRE Aptitude and Advanced scores in one of the sciences are recommended for all applicants whose undergraduate work has been completed outside Canada. | In such cases, all of the requirements for entry into the MASc program must be satisfied.

toefl_min.value: Biomedical Engineering asks for TOEFL iBT 100.
toefl_min.quote: Department-specific English language requirements | Biomedical Engineering 100 7.5 A

ielts_min.quote: Department-specific English language requirements | Biomedical Engineering 100 7.5 A

notes: Department minimum GPA 3.3/4.3; most admits have 3.7 or better.
